_note: Every number below was read from a source fetched on 2026-11-23. status: published = stated in the source; derived = computed here from published numbers; assumption = not published in any source reached, swept over the stated range.

retest_sd_diff_low_ms.detail: SD of P100 latency difference between two recordings about 2 days apart, 75 eyes of 39 patients, after blinded verification of cursor placement

retest_sd_diff_unverified_ms.detail: same, 77 eyes, before verification; not used in the sweep, shown for scale

retest_sd_diff_high_ms.detail: SD of P100 difference between two visits one week apart, per eye, 15 people; 6.5 ms (17' checks), 6.3 ms (34' checks)

planning_sd_ms.detail: common SD of VEP change used for the sample size; the protocol says the ReBUILD value was about 4.1 ms and 20% was added

retest_df.detail: 39 patients minus 1; eyes of one person are not independent, so people are counted

effects.label: crossover estimate
effects.detail: latency delay reduced by 1.7 ms/eye, 95% CI 0.5 to 2.9, p=0.0048

effects.label: delayed-treatment estimate
effects.detail: the protocol paper quotes 3.2 ms for the ReBUILD delayed-treatment analysis

sd_status.detail: the SD of the within-person treated-minus-control difference per participant is not published. Swept from the lowest to the highest published test-retest SD of differences, with the protocol planning SD in between. The registry reports per-eye change SDs of 6.85 ms (clemastine periods) and 3.86 ms (placebo periods), 93 eyes.

other_assumptions: equal noise in both periods although they lasted 90 and 60 days

n_source.detail: 52 randomised, 26 per arm. The number analysed (completers) is not in the abstract; 26 per arm is an upper limit and an assumption.

CCMR One (bexarotene), lesional MTR.outcome: change in mean lesional MTR, percentage units (primary outcome)

sd_status.detail: SD of change 0.84 pu on placebo (0.98 pu on bexarotene)

n_source.detail: the exploratory VEP effect is for eyes with baseline latency above 118 ms. A later paper counts 51 such eyes from 28 participants. The split between arms is not given; 14 and 14 is assumed.

CCMR One (bexarotene), VEP.outcome: full-field VEP P100 latency, ms (exploratory outcome)

effects.label: eyes with baseline above 118 ms
effects.detail: the follow-up paper quotes -4.06 ms for the original trial in these eyes; no CI given there

sd_status.detail: SD of VEP change in this trial was not found in any source reached. Same sweep as above.

CCMR Two (metformin + clemastine).outcome: full-field VEP P100 latency, ms (primary outcome)

effects.label: adjusted difference
effects.detail: -1.2 ms, 95% CI -2.4 to -0.1, p=0.042; conference report only

sd_status.detail: SD of change not reported. 2.4 ms is derived: the reported CI implies a standard error of 0.59 ms, which with 33 and 34 independent participants needs a residual SD of 2.4 ms. The trial analysed eyes and adjusted for covariates, so this is a lower limit, not a published SD. 5.0 ms is the protocol's planning value.

moderator_assumption.detail: for the moderator column only: responder status is tied to one of two pre-specified covariates with correlation 0.7 on the latent scale. Nothing published supports any particular value; 0.7 is a favourable case.
